description: Use this when the user has a 17-character VIN and wants the window sticker (Monroney label), build sheet, factory options list, packages, original MSRP, trim, engine, recalls or paint code for that vehicle, for example to check a used car or a listing's claims. Works for any make sold new in the US. The check is free and needs no account or key. For the VIN it returns: the decoded year, make, model, trim, engine, drivetrain, transmission, body, fuel and assembly plant; whether the original factory window sticker is on file; when no original is on file, whether a window sticker rebuilt from the VIN's factory build data (not the original printed label) can be made; how many recalls were issued for the model, with NHTSA's open-recall check for the VIN; where the paint code label is on that make; and a link to the StickerByVIN page for the VIN. Original stickers are on file mainly for Ford, Lincoln, Chevrolet, GMC, Buick, Cadillac, Jeep, Ram, Dodge, Chrysler, Fiat, Alfa Romeo, Hyundai, Genesis, Kia, Toyota, Lexus, Mitsubishi, Nissan and Infiniti (a factory sticker copy from the dealer system) and 2021 and later Subaru; coverage varies by model year. For other makes, such as Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Volkswagen, Audi, Honda, Acura, Mazda, Porsche, Volvo and Tesla, and for VINs with no original on file, the rebuilt sticker is offered for model year 1981 and later (for older vehicles it can be built only when factory build data exists for that car). The sticker (original or rebuilt) lists the factory options and packages with their prices and the MSRP; this tool says whether one exists but does not list the options or prices itself. It does not return accident, title, ownership or mileage history or a market value.

vin.description: The 17-character Vehicle Identification Number, as printed on the dashboard, door jamb, title or listing. Letters I, O and Q never appear in a VIN.

name: check_window_sticker

decoded.description: Decoded from the VIN (NHTSA). The VIN does not contain options, packages, prices or the paint code.

details_url.description: The StickerByVIN page for this VIN

factory_options_and_msrp.description: Where the factory options, packages, prices and MSRP for this VIN can be found. This tool does not list them.

open_recall_check_url.description: NHTSA's official open-recall check for this exact VIN

original_window_sticker.description: Whether the original factory window sticker (or the carmaker's own sticker copy) is on file for this exact VIN

paint_code_location.description: Where the paint code label is on this make. The VIN does not contain the paint code.

rebuilt_window_sticker.description: When no original is on file: whether a window sticker rebuilt from this VIN's factory build data can be made. It is a recreation, not the original printed label.

status.description: available = can be made for this VIN; paused = can be made but new requests are paused for a few hours; not_needed = an original is on file; not_available = not offered for this VIN

recalls_for_model.description: Recall campaigns issued for this model and year (not only open ones on this car); null when NHTSA could not be checked (unknown, not zero)

title: Window sticker, build sheet and options check by VIN
